newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bkk of Commerce delisting said unlikely.
newsitem.headline: Bkk of Commerce delisting said unlikely.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Thursday said its bailout plan for the troubled Bangkok Bank of Commerce would help prevent the bank share's from being delisted by the stock exchange.
"If the rehabilitation plan for Bangkok Bank of Commerce is effective, I don't think the bank's shares will be delisted," an assistant governor Chusri Daengprapi at the central bank told reporters.
Chusri is also a member of the bank's government-appointed controlling committee.
Bangkok Bank of Commerce's shares were heavily offloaded on Thursday after an 11-month suspension was lifted by the bourse for a month to assess if the counter needs to be delisted.
